description: Use this when testing a parser, serializer, validator, or state machine where an invariant is articulable, when a fixed parametrize table feels insufficient for an unbounded input space, when seeding regression cases for a property test, or when a bug shipped that example tests missed. Covers @given strategy selection (st.text/integers/binary/composite/from_type), @settings budgets and named profiles, @example seeding, @reproduce_failure replay, @assume vs strategy.filter, common property templates (round-trip, idempotence, monotonicity, bound), RuleBasedStateMachine for stateful testing, target() for guided search, and .hypothesis/ database persistence. Triggers: hypothesis, @given, @settings, @example, @assume, @reproduce_failure, st.text, st.integers, st.composite, st.from_type, RuleBasedStateMachine, target.
